title: should set the Browser Steps allowance and update the row's Browser Steps Total cell
verifies: setting a whole-number ceiling on the Browser Steps tab persists and the row's Browser Steps Total cell re-renders to the new value

title: should set the Protocol Steps allowance and update the row's Protocol Steps Total cell
verifies: setting a whole-number ceiling on the Protocol Steps tab persists and the row's Protocol Steps Total cell re-renders to the new value

title: should set the quota usage limit as a ceiling, not an increment
verifies: PUT usage_limit returns 200 with limit equal to the sent value and the org list reflects the replacement ceiling

title: should default to the AI Credits tab and only mount the steps input after selecting a synthetics tab
verifies: the dialog opens on AI Credits and the shared steps input is absent until a synthetics tab is selected

title: should keep the dialog open and show an error for invalid steps input
verifies: empty / negative / non-integer steps values keep the dialog open and show the matching Zod error message

title: should close the dialog on cancel without changing the Browser Steps Total cell
verifies: the secondary button closes the dialog with no request and the cell value is unchanged

title: should expose step-quota fields in the GET organizations response
verifies: GET /api/_meta/organizations returns a { data: [...] } envelope with numeric step-quota columns

title: should swap the steps input label between Browser and Protocol tabs
verifies: the shared steps input label follows the active Browser/Protocol tab

title: should return 4xx for unauthorized / unknown pool / missing org
verifies: the quota endpoint returns 401 for non-meta, 400 for an unknown pool, and 404 for a missing org
